Alphabet's consolidated revenues for the year ended December 31, 2022, were $282,836 million.

Looking at the quarterly revenues for 2022:
*   Q1 2022 revenues were $68,011 million. This was a 23% change in revenues year over year, or 26% in constant currency.
*   Q2 2022 revenues were $69,685 million. This represented a 13% change in revenues year over year, or 16% in constant currency.
*   Q4 2022 consolidated revenues were $76,048 million, which was up 1% year over year, or up 7% in constant currency.

For the year-to-date period ending June 30, 2022, Alphabet's revenues were $137,696 million.

Specific revenue breakdowns for Q4 2022 include:
*   Google Search & other: $42,604 million.
*   YouTube ads: $7,963 million.
*   Google Network: $8,475 million.
*   Google advertising: $59,042 million.
